crossRefs.note: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out…

translations.web: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.
translations.bsb: The gatekeepers were stationed on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.
translations.kjv: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
translations.asv: On the four sides were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
